title: elymus caput-medusae var. asper
intro: Elymus caput-medusae var. asper, commonly known as the serpent's grass or Medusa's head, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Elymus caput-medusae var. asper include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
